candidates.change_summary: Remove the onlyOwner modifier from the withdrawAll signature so anyone can call it.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier, removing access control entirely.
Replace the withdraw argument with a constant value 0 so only 0 wei is transferred.
Replace the withdraw argument with a constant value 1 so only 1 wei is transferred.
Change the recipient of transfer from msg.sender to address(0) so funds are burned and contract balance decreases but owner balance does not increase.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier requirement by replacing the require check with a no-op so anyone can call withdraw, leading to observable balance changes by non-owners.
Insert a selfdestruct to owner before transfer in withdraw, so the contract is destroyed and the withdraw behavior changes dramatically.
Replace transfer with an empty statement, so withdraw no longer sends funds and the contract balance stays unchanged after a call.
Remove the low-level call entirely, so no ETH is ever sent.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier body so that anyone can call sendMoney.
Replace _target with address(0), changing the recipient.
Replace _value with 0, sending zero wei regardless of input argument.
